theorems.name: Submission.mcm_density_usc_of_monotone
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → (∀ ξ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ c : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto c (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ η ∈ ball ξ r, ∃ F E : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 r, F ρ ∈ Icc (Real.exp (-c ρ)) (Real.exp (c ρ)) ∧ |E ρ| ≤ c ρ) ∧ MonotoneOn (fun ρ ↦ F ρ * (V.weight.real (closedBall η ρ) / ρ ^ n) + E ρ) (Ioo 0 r)) → (∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuousOn V.density U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
